notes.title: Update 0.4.1.2
notes.notes:
Please note: Due to the world map position bug mentioned below, your position in the world map will be reset to the divinator tower upon first load. After this initial reset should work as normal

UI
	[list]
[*] Add crafting filter to inventories to better contain items for combining, add sort icon to sort button
[*] 	Updated exit button graphic
[*] 	Rework panel that pops up when at location in world map
[/list]

Removed the default Inverted camera approach on the minimap
Rock spider makes sounds on attack

Fixes
[list]
[*] 	Goat demon, human, corrupted, snail, hyga demon and others not playing blood particle effect on hit

[*] 	Sacrifice process bugging out when at very low FPS (< 15)
[*] 	Cannot pick up certain paper items
[*] 	Broom inventory icon very small
[*] 	Player on inventory hold bow wrong
[*] 	Cannot exit save prompt without something typed in
[*] 	Rune screen showing incorrect runes on your equipment when switching pages
[*] 	Bug where shuffling save files (loading one save, then starting a new game save) could make the position on the world map retain from previous save files
[/list]
	
	Various other minor fixes
